system.description: Bind your soul to Sanctuaries — small places of spiritual and historical weight, found through story; each carries a Haunt and a Ritual. In a conflict: action + 5/10/15 MP (escalating within a turn, resetting each turn) Haunts a creature you hold a Bond with — never yourself — at any distance. One creature per Sanctuary, one Sanctuary per creature; banishing is free on your turn.
